title: Unstoppable window vs storm length (stun part UNSUPPORTED)
question: How long does Unstoppable last with Superior Duration and Diviner's Kevlar, and what share of the storm does it cover? Does casting it right before the ult change the storm (Arcane Surge consumption)?
hypothesis: H-L2: Unstoppable modifier lasts 5.5 x (1 + 0.28 + 0.15) = 7.9 s (7.0 s with Superior Duration only) while the storm lasts ~20-22 s, so it covers 31-39%. The stun-interrupt half (does a stun after the window end the storm) is UNSUPPORTED: no op applies CC to the player (GAPS.md 7).

setup.position: mid lane, bots on a 300 u ring (inside the 40 m storm)

controls: Same position and spawn distance (enemies 3 at 300 u ring, main target 350 u)
hardreset between blocks (fresh cooldowns, no items)
Same souls/level/ability tiers (unlock 7) in every arm except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP keep-alive (ekeep 0.9) and resists
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
procedure: cast i1 0.1; then 'mods' every 0.5 s for 10 s (wait 0.5 / mods x20)
cast 4 22 with enemies 3 to read storm length in the same block

metrics.name: unstoppable_s
metrics.how: first/last 'mods' line listing the Unstoppable modifier

decision.rule: UNST_SD_KEV within 0.5 s of 7.9 s supports the coverage maths; stun-interrupt stays UNSUPPORTED until a player-CC op exists

blockedIfNo: op that stuns the player (for the interrupt half)
